items.title: Jack Kelly Interview, 1963-11-17
items.q: He made Keller's love behind his own name.

ctx.x: See, man with a mirror, buy your home safe. Well, at that period of time, $110 wasn't a lot of money. Oh, yeah. So she bought a good one home for a hundred and ten dollars. And it was really cool. I mean, that period of time, you know, cause there's no money now. But I mean, then it was, you know, plenty more than you. So she gave him a hundred and ten dollars next morning to buy my home. So he bought a good one home with flowers in it. And he blew the bag off. And he blew the bag off. And he blew the bag off.…
